experiment: V52 frozen V51 fresh-machine external validation on unused LDM-UPB runs
classification: one-shot fresh-machine external validation within a previously represented dataset family; not a fresh-dataset validation

source_record.title: Run-to-failure data set of ball bearings subjected to time-varying load and speed conditions

selection.rule: the four smallest unused single-ZIP bearing archives in the authoritative Zenodo record
selection.rationale: label-free selection that maximizes the number of fresh machine experiments under an approximately 8 GB acquisition budget

scientific_unit.same_machine_bearings: channels belonging to the same physical bearing are aggregated into one 100-dimensional acquisition vector and are never counted as independent machines

frozen_detector.input_normalization: device-local robust center and scale on acquisitions [0,8)
frozen_detector.score_calibration: device-local robust z score on acquisitions [20,84), m=64, with V43 EPC bootstrap correction

adapter_lock.required_parity: exact bitwise reproduction of all 767 frozen B12 V19 feature vectors before candidate download

acquisition_transport.transport_record_equivalence: earlier immutable version containing B01/B02/B04/B05 with byte-identical published archive sizes and MD5 checksums
acquisition_transport.logical_input_integrity: complete ordered vibration-member inventory; every MAT member must match Zenodo-published uncompressed byte count and CRC32
acquisition_transport.archive_md5_role: provenance only; monolithic ZIP bytes are not required after the transport amendment

timing_proxy.premature: first alarm before 60% of stored life
timing_proxy.valid: first alarm at or after 60% and before 90%

outcome_blindness.warning: the 60/90 percent boundaries are normalized-life evaluation proxies, not verified physical degradation onset

claim_limits: A pass supports fresh-machine transfer within LDM-UPB only.
Four machines are too few for a strong generalization or specificity claim.
No fully healthy run is present, so healthy-machine specificity is not estimated by V52.
A failure is retained and reported; V52 may not be rescued by moving the threshold or changing persistence.
